dialogue_texts: The sun has fully breached the horizon. The parallel layer has slipped away, and your window of opportunity for the night is officially closed.

How utterly exasperating. To think I spent the entire night weaving through eternity and manipulating history, only to be forced back by a simple sunrise. I have zero answers and a spectacular headache.

You commanded the flow of time with immense precision, Kaguya. But the glohm within that distortion didn't just resist your spells - it actively fed on the concept of your eternity to stabilize itself.
Without a direct strike to the core, we were just spinning our wheels.

Failing to clear a midnight incident before dawn is just bad for royal business. That is just bad for business. If word gets out that the empress can't handle a little midnight distortion, I'm going to lose my edge.
It is worse than a blow to your reputation. Look closely at your hands. The glohm didn't fade when the sun came up. It's settling directly into your spirit font.
Ugh... my fragile little mind is being warped... I'm feeling heavy! Like my very immortality is trying to drag me down into the earth.
The glohm is anchoring itself inside you because we left the core intact. What is your next move? It will only burrow deeper if you leave it alone.
Too bad! Bad ending! To see the good ending, clear the game without using a continue or letting nine hours pass.
